name: Fox Wave Clean
summary: Fox Wave Clean is an Elliott Wave-based EA that identifies wave patterns (impulse and corrective waves) on multiple timeframes to generate trade signals. It enters positions at the end of corrective waves (wave 2 or wave 4) anticipating the next impulse wave. The EA uses a rule-based wave counting algorithm with Fibonacci retracement levels for entry and take-profit placement.
summary_zh: Fox Wave Clean是一个基于艾略特波浪理论的EA，通过识别多周期的波浪形态（推动浪和调整浪）来生成交易信号。它在调整浪（第2浪或第4浪）结束时入场，预期下一个推动浪的到来。该EA使用基于规则的波浪计数算法，结合斐波那契回撤水平来确定入场点和止盈位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于艾略特波浪理论，通过识别5浪推动结构和3浪调整结构来捕捉趋势中的交易机会。入场条件是在识别到第2浪或第4浪调整结束且价格回撤至斐波那契关键位（如38.2%、50%、61.8%）时开仓，预期第3浪或第5浪的推动行情。出场条件包括在斐波那契扩展位设置止盈目标（通常为第3浪的161.8%扩展）以及基于波浪结构失效的止损。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额百分比的方式，但没有复杂的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，止损通常设置在波浪起点下方，风险回报比理论上可以达到1:2以上。该EA还使用了多时间框架分析，在高级别时间框架确认波浪方向后在低级别时间框架寻找精确入场点。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on Elliott Wave Theory, identifying 5-wave impulse structures and 3-wave corrective structures to capture trading opportunities within trends. Entry conditions trigger when wave 2 or wave 4 corrections are identified as complete and price retraces to key Fibonacci levels (38.2%, 50%, 61.8%), anticipating the next impulse wave (wave 3 or wave 5). Exit conditions include take-profit targets set at Fibonacci extension levels (typically 161.8% extension of wave 3) and stop-losses based on wave structure invalidation. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a percentage of account balance, but lacks sophisticated dynamic position adjustment. Money management sets stop-losses below the wave origin point, achieving theoretical risk-reward ratios above 1:2. The EA also employs multi-timeframe analysis, confirming wave direction on higher timeframes before seeking precise entry points on lower timeframes.

parameters.name: FibLevel
parameters.description: 斐波那契回撤入场水平

pros: 基于艾略特波浪理论，逻辑框架完整，能捕捉大级别趋势行情
使用斐波那契回撤和扩展作为关键价位，入场和出场具有量化标准
多时间框架分析提高了波浪识别的准确性，减少了虚假信号
风险回报比理论上较高，符合趋势跟踪策略的优势特征
pros_en: Based on Elliott Wave Theory with a complete logical framework, capable of capturing major trend moves
Uses Fibonacci retracements and extensions as key levels, providing quantified standards for entries and exits
Multi-timeframe analysis improves wave counting accuracy and reduces false signals
Theoretical risk-reward ratio is favorable, consistent with trend-following strategy advantages
cons: 波浪计数具有主观性，不同交易者可能对同一行情得出不同的波浪划分，算法的准确性有限
在震荡行情中波浪识别容易出错，可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺少动态仓位管理和加仓机制，无法在波浪确认后逐步增加头寸
止损设置可能过大，在波浪结构失效时可能造成较大单笔亏损
cons_en: Wave counting is inherently subjective; the algorithm may produce different wave labels than experienced analysts, limiting accuracy
Wave identification is error-prone in ranging/choppy markets, potentially generating frequent false signals and consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic position sizing and pyramiding mechanisms, unable to scale into positions as wave confirmation strengthens
Stop-loss placement may be too wide, potentially causing significant single-trade losses when wave structure invalidates
improvements: 增加波浪识别的置信度过滤机制，例如结合动量指标（RSI/MACD）确认波浪方向，减少虚假信号
添加震荡行情检测器，在市场无明显趋势时暂停交易，避免在调整阶段频繁开仓
improvements_en: Add a confidence filter for wave identification, such as combining momentum indicators (RSI/MACD) to confirm wave direction and reduce false signals
Implement a ranging market detector to pause trading when no clear trend exists, avoiding frequent entries during corrective phases

risk_points: 波浪识别的主观性可能导致策略在高波动或震荡市场中产生连续亏损
止损基于波浪结构而非固定点数，可能导致不同交易间风险敞口差异较大
缺少最大回撤控制和每日亏损限制等资金保护机制
risk_points_en: Subjective nature of wave identification may cause consecutive losses in volatile or ranging markets
Stop-loss based on wave structure rather than fixed pips may lead to inconsistent risk exposure across trades
Lacks equity protection mechanisms such as maximum drawdown control and daily loss limits
